label: Doctor's tip · B12
head: How much B12
do you need?
name: Dr. Michael Klaper
end_cta: Find Dr. Michael Klaper on Vegans Explore

captions.text: Nowadays, they're taking those same B12-producing microbes,
they culture it in big vats,
and they isolate the B12 and put it into
these little liquids and sprays and tablets.
And that's where to get it. No animal has to die.
And you don't need it every day if you're otherwise healthy.
You know, three times a week,
put 1,000 micrograms of vitamin B12 under your tongue
if it's a drop or one of those little sublingual micro dots.
Don't neglect it, 'cause you can really damage
your spinal cord and your peripheral nerves.
Don't neglect it, but don't let it be an obstacle.
